common.folder-render.title: Some folders could not be displayed.
common.folder-render.help: Containers and VMs remain accessible. Review the affected folders in Settings, then reload this page.
request.failure.refresh: The page security information is missing or expired. Refresh the Unraid webGUI, then retry your change.
request.failure.session: Unraid rejected the session security check. Refresh the webGUI and sign in again if prompted, then retry your change.
request.failure.origin: The page address does not match the server request. If you use a reverse proxy, try direct Unraid access and check the proxy headers.
request.failure.marker: The request security marker did not reach the plugin. Hard-refresh the webGUI; if this continues, check browser extensions or proxy filtering.
request.failure.state: The plugin could not prepare secure changes. Check the plugin logs and export a sanitized support bundle.
request.failure.guard: The plugin rejected this change. Refresh the webGUI and check whether it was already applied before trying again. Include this support code if the problem continues.
